name: workflow-doc-to-tasks
description: Read a project knowledge doc, use Cursor (trigger_cursor_worker) to author new backlog tasks in the New swimlane, verify status New, then tell the user tasks are ready for review (and post to Mattermost when configured).

steps.name: resolve_doc_context
steps.prompt:
WORKFLOW INPUT (preserve project_id, trigger task id, doc path, and goal through your reply):
{{input}}

**Phase 1 — doc-to-tasks context.** This pipeline turns a **knowledge doc** into **new** backlog tasks in the **New** swimlane (status **New** — ready for triage/review, not In Progress). Parse and confirm:
- `project_id` (UUID) from the channel context line or user message
- **Trigger task id** from the input (see `Workflow task id:` if present) — authorizes the run (was **Ready for Dev** when started; do not mark it Done unless the user asked)
- **Knowledge doc**: resolve to a markdown file path — accept repo-relative path, absolute path, or unambiguous doc id/reference (e.g. `doc 11`)
- **Goal**: planning objective; if omitted, default to: `derive atomic, testable backlog tasks from the document`

Resolve the **absolute spoke root** for `trigger_cursor_worker` (from `repo:<spoke>` labels, project spokes, or an explicit path). Ask for clarification only when doc resolution is ambiguous or missing.

If the workflow input contains `[OpenFang channel context: ...]`, include that **verbatim** line in your summary so later phases can use `mattermost_channel_id` for `channel_send`.

Reply with a concise structured summary: trigger_task_id, project_id, absolute_doc_path, absolute_workspace, goal, plus any channel context line.

steps.name: cursor_create_tasks_from_doc
steps.prompt:
Prior phase output (carry forward all identifiers):
{{input}}

**Phase 2 — Cursor generates tasks from the doc (primary work).** Do **not** create tasks yourself in this phase (no orchestrator backlog create tool) unless Cursor failed and you must report that failure — the backlog skill expects **Cursor** to author the markdown bodies.

Call `trigger_cursor_worker` with:
- `workspace`: absolute spoke path from phase 1
- `mode`: **agent**
- `behavior`: Follow `.cursor/skills/backlog/SKILL.md` in that workspace: CLI only for task metadata (`backlog task create`, `backlog task edit` for status/labels/deps); all Description, Acceptance Criteria, Implementation Plan, and Implementation Notes live in the task markdown with the required `<!-- SECTION:... -->` / `<!-- AC:... -->` markers; never pass long prose via CLI flags.
- `prompt`: Instruct Cursor to: (1) open and read the knowledge doc at **absolute_doc_path**; (2) apply the **goal**; (3) create **atomic**, testable tasks via `backlog task create "<Title>"` (optional `-l` / `--priority` only); (4) edit each new `backlog/tasks/task-<id> - <Title>.md` per the skill; (5) set every **new** task to status **New** (`backlog task edit <id> -s "New"`) so they appear in the **New** swimlane/column for review; (6) return a definitive list of created **task ids and titles**.

Summarize Cursor’s outcome: created TASK ids, any errors. Do not run implementation or `enforce_quality_gate` on these new tasks unless the user explicitly asked.

steps.name: confirm_new_and_notify_user
steps.prompt:
Prior phase output (carry forward project_id, doc reference, and Cursor’s list of created tasks):
{{input}}

**Phase 3 — verify New swimlane + user confirmation.**

1. **Verify status**: For each task Cursor claimed to create, confirm it exists and status is **New** using `backlog_task_view` or `query_project_status` with `project_id`. If any is not New, fix with `backlog_task_edit` … `-s "New"` when appropriate.

2. **Tell the user (mandatory)**: Your reply must clearly state:
   - Doc-to-tasks is **complete**.
   - **How many** tasks were created.
   - Each **TASK id** and **title**.
   - They are in the **New** swimlane (status **New**) and **ready for review** in the backlog/kanban before anyone picks them up for implementation.

3. **Mattermost (when applicable)**: If you can obtain `mattermost_channel_id` for this project (e.g. from `read_project_context` with `project_id`, or from a `[OpenFang channel context: … mattermost_channel_id=…]` line carried in the workflow input from earlier turns), call `channel_send` with `channel`: **mattermost**, `recipient`: that channel id, and a short message echoing the same summary (created count, TASK ids, **ready for review** in **New**).
   - If there is no channel id or `channel_send` fails, still complete step 2 in full; do not invent a send.

4. Do not start `workflow-full-cycle` or mark the trigger planning task Done unless the user asked.
